- 0000000000.blkz: mainnet blocks 0..200 (raw RLP, 4-byte big-endian length prefix each, raw DEFLATE), cut from ~/cache/mainnet/0000000000.blk, which goempo-dev fetch filled from debug_getRawBlock on a private mainnet RPC node.
- mainnet_block_44085599.hex, mainnet_block_44107198.hex, mainnet_block_44107199.hex, mainnet_block_44107200.hex: debug_getRawBlock from a private mainnet RPC node on 2026-11-17: the last blocks of epochs 2040 and 2041 (their extraData carries the DKG outcome installing the next epoch's identity) and the first block of epoch 2042. Certificates for 44107199 and 44107200 come from ../../consensus/testdata/mainnet_finalizations.jsonl.
- devnet_genesis.json: genesis of the 4-validator Rust tempo devnet made by scripts/devnet/devnet.sh gen (epoch length 60, chain id 1337); its block hash 0x1b259d37...2264 is what the Rust nodes logged.
